component.name: alibaba-sls
component.title: Alibaba Simple Log Service (SLS)
component.description: Write logs, query logs, and list Logstores on Alibaba Cloud Simple Log Service (SLS).
component.label: cloud,monitoring

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

CamelAlibabaSlsOperation.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. This header replaces the operation option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the operation option.

CamelAlibabaSlsProject.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsProject.description: The name of the project. This header replaces the project option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the project option.

CamelAlibabaSlsLogStoreName.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsLogStoreName.description: The name of the Logstore for putLogs and getLogs. The producer writes the logs to this Logstore for putLogs, and queries its logs for getLogs. This header replaces the logStoreName option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the logStoreName option.

CamelAlibabaSlsQuery.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsQuery.description: The search statement or analytic statement for getLogs. This header replaces the query option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the query option.

CamelAlibabaSlsFrom.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsFrom.description: The start time for getLogs, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Simple Log Service requires a start time. This header replaces the from option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the from option.

CamelAlibabaSlsTo.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsTo.description: The end time for getLogs, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Simple Log Service requires an end time. This header replaces the to option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the to option.

CamelAlibabaSlsLine.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsLine.description: The maximum number of logs to return for getLogs. Simple Log Service accepts a value of at most 100. Simple Log Service does not use it when query contains an analytic statement. This header replaces the line option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the line option.

CamelAlibabaSlsOffset.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsOffset.description: The offset of the first log to return for getLogs. Simple Log Service does not use it when query contains an analytic statement. This header replaces the offset option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the offset option.

CamelAlibabaSlsTopic.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsTopic.description: The log topic for getLogs. This header replaces the topic option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the topic option.

CamelAlibabaSlsReverse.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsReverse.description: Whether to return logs in descending order of log timestamps for getLogs. Simple Log Service does not use it when query contains an analytic statement. This header replaces the reverse option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the reverse option.

CamelAlibabaSlsLogstoreName.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsLogstoreName.description: The name of the Logstore for listLogStores. Simple Log Service returns the Logstores whose name contains the value. If this header is not set, the producer uses an exchange property of the same name. If neither of the two is set, the producer adds no Logstore name to the request.

CamelAlibabaSlsMode.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsMode.description: The type of the Logstore for listLogStores. The value must be standard or query. If this header is not set, the producer uses an exchange property of the same name. If neither of the two is set, the producer adds no Logstore type to the request.

CamelAlibabaSlsSize.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsSize.description: The number of entries per page for listLogStores. Simple Log Service accepts a value of at most 500. If this header is not set, the producer uses an exchange property of the same name. If neither of the two is set, the producer adds no number of entries per page to the request.

CamelAlibabaSlsListOffset.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsListOffset.description: The offset of the first Logstore to return for listLogStores. If this header is not set, the producer uses an exchange property of the same name. If neither of the two is set, the producer adds no offset to the request.

CamelAlibabaSlsTelemetryType.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsTelemetryType.description: The telemetry type for listLogStores. The value must be None for logs or Metrics for metrics. If this header is not set, the producer uses an exchange property of the same name. If neither of the two is set, the producer adds no telemetry type to the request.

CamelAlibabaSlsRequestId.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsRequestId.description: The request ID that Simple Log Service returns in the response to the operation. The producer sets it when the response has one.

CamelAlibabaSlsStatusCode.label: producer
CamelAlibabaSlsStatusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the response to the operation. The producer sets it, unless the exchange fails.

producerIn.description: The logs to write for putLogs: a LogGroup or a PutLogsRequest of the SLS SDK, any other body fails. getLogs and listLogStores do not read the body, they take their input from options and headers

producerOut.description: A Map of the response with its statusCode and headers. For getLogs the GetLogsResponseBody of the SLS SDK is under body, for listLogStores the names under logstores with count and total

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAlibabaSlsOperation header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of Simple Log Service, which is a host name without http:// or https://, for example cn-hangzhou.log.aliyuncs.com. The producer sends requests over HTTPS to the endpoint, with the name of the project in front of it. If not set, the region option determines the endpoint, and one of the two is required. Not used when the slsClient option is set or autowired.

logStoreName.description: The name of the Logstore for putLogs and getLogs. The producer writes the logs to this Logstore for putLogs, and queries its logs for getLogs. The CamelAlibabaSlsLogStoreName header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. One of the three is required for putLogs and getLogs.

project.description: The name of the project. The CamelAlibabaSlsProject header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. One of the three is required.

region.description: The region ID of Simple Log Service, for example cn-hangzhou. Only used when the endpoint option is not set, to build the endpoint of Simple Log Service. Not used when the slsClient option is set or autowired.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

slsClient.label: advanced
slsClient.description: To use a custom com.aliyun.sls20201230.Client. The producer sends its requests with this client, and the region, endpoint, accessKey, secretKey and serviceKeys options are not used. If no client is set or autowired, the Camel endpoint creates a client from these options. It creates this client when the producer processes its first message.

from.label: getLogs
from.description: The start time for getLogs, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Simple Log Service requires a start time. The CamelAlibabaSlsFrom header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no start time to the request.

line.label: getLogs
line.description: The maximum number of logs to return for getLogs. Simple Log Service accepts a value of at most 100. Simple Log Service does not use it when query contains an analytic statement. The CamelAlibabaSlsLine header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no maximum number of logs to the request.

offset.label: getLogs
offset.description: The offset of the first log to return for getLogs. Simple Log Service does not use it when query contains an analytic statement. The CamelAlibabaSlsOffset header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no offset to the request.

query.label: getLogs
query.description: The search statement or analytic statement for getLogs. The CamelAlibabaSlsQuery header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no search statement or analytic statement to the request.

reverse.label: getLogs
reverse.description: Whether to return logs in descending order of log timestamps for getLogs. Simple Log Service does not use it when query contains an analytic statement. The CamelAlibabaSlsReverse header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no sort order to the request.

to.label: getLogs
to.description: The end time for getLogs, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Simple Log Service requires an end time. The CamelAlibabaSlsTo header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no end time to the request.

topic.label: getLogs
topic.description: The log topic for getLogs. The CamelAlibabaSlsTopic header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no log topic to the request.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The AccessKey ID of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to Simple Log Service. If not set, the accessKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the slsClient option is set or autowired.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The AccessKey secret of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to Simple Log Service. If not set, the secretKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the slsClient option is set or autowired.

serviceKeys.label: security
serviceKeys.description: The AccessKey pair as an org.apache.camel.component.alibaba.common.models.ServiceKeys. Its accessKey is the AccessKey ID and its secretKey is the AccessKey secret. Each of the two is used when the option of the same name is not set. Not used when the slsClient option is set or autowired.
